title: 浅角舒适撑立
description: 水彩描绘浅内角中适度分立的低位站姿，两面脚点清楚可见。

art_direction.medium: clean cel-shaded sports animation with crisp anatomy and soft environmental light
art_direction.scene: Create an original watercolor illustration of a fictional adult in a shallow indoor corner using a comfortable stemming stance. Positive low footholds sit on both adjoining wall faces, large teal handholds offer relaxed support, and the knees follow the shoe directions naturally without an extreme split. The climber remains close to the continuous thick crash mat that wraps into the corner. Use a wide frontal-oblique view with the whole opaque-clothed adult and both planes clearly visible. Pale peach washes, soft blue shadows, and warm window light create a peaceful gym setting. Preserve credible contact points and adult proportions. No jumping, captions, logos, high exposure, or forced flexibility.
